summary: HUTCHMED (China) Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that the US FDA granted Orphan Drug Designation to sovleplenib for autoimmune hemolytic anemia, its second such designation after primary ITP in October 2026. No financial terms, ownership changes, or transactional mechanics are disclosed; the item is a routine product-development disclosure, and the registrant retains worldwide rights to sovleplenib. Chinese NDAs for primary ITP and warm AIHA remain under NMPA review. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
